title: Siege of Montargis
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Montargis", at revision 1378505042, opens: "The siege of Montargis took place during the Hundred Years War. A French relief army under Jean de Dunois routed an English force led by the Earl of Warwick." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q39071913, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1427 siege that took place during the Hundred Years War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
